extras: Freemium: recording, notes, and transcription/polish of recordings up to 5 minutes are free; longer recordings, live translation, dictation, speaker labeling, Todo collection, and imported/computer-audio transcription require a paid license key (search RedNote for 焦应行). Closed-source and minified/obfuscated to protect license verification; no telemetry. Resojot CLI is a testing feature whose contract may change. Full guides are in the Resojot knowledge base. Warning: do not publish .obsidian/plugins/resojot/data.json; it may contain settings and legacy credentials.
problem: Turning spoken recordings into searchable, organized text notes normally requires stitching together separate recording, transcription, and cleanup tools.
